scientific_snapshot.G_batch_ideal: (current admitted edges minus all selected old satellite edges) union all selected new satellite edges
scientific_snapshot.unchanged_other_pending_transitions: Remain current-state edges for snapshot; idealize only this selected batch.
scientific_snapshot.route_recompute: Selected frozen common router on entire ideal topology, same root node/commodity state
scientific_snapshot.demand: Frozen evaluator: Q>state_tol => infinite local demand; else positive current source/inflight input => finite demand; in-flight-only without local demand has Psi=0.
scientific_snapshot.R_snap: Minimum actual equal_weight_fair_share allocation over current positive local demand nodes, not equal division by all route-using commodities
scientific_snapshot.V: sum_{f:N_f>0} [N_f*C_prop_f + Psi_f]; Psi=N_f^2/(2R_snap) if demands exist, otherwise0
scientific_snapshot.infinity_rule: Both HOLD/candidate infinity => not positive improvement; finite candidate vs infinity HOLD => +infinity improvement; never calculate NaN infinity-infinity.

baselines.name: STATIC/HOLD
baselines.rule: Always HOLD, same geometry/events/traffic/drain; natural expiry applies.

baselines.name: Batch Ignore-Setup
baselines.rule: argmin V_v2 over HOLD and every shared executable ideal batch topology
baselines.decision_setup_consequence: ignored in V; physical legality still real

definition.hold_eligibility: For each member: now-old_link.active_link_start >= minimum_hold_s, all members eligible.
definition.timer_reset: new link actual LINK_UP timestamp, not accepted-command time; initial links use explicit supplied ages (propose active_link_start=0 for same constructed initial state).

history.old_clock: global last_accepted_switch_time; first switch has no hold block

definition.5s_sampling: If link_up=0, H4 first eligible t=5, H8 t=10. General elapsed eligibility H<=actual_hold<H+5 absent other blockage; never convert H to epoch counts.
definition.threshold_boundary: B1 chooses positive deltaV; threshold equality accepted; exact HOLD tie still HOLD.
definition.shared_pool: Read same pool; apply own per-link eligibility to its members without regenerating advantaged proposals.
definition.final_robustness_inclusion: Proposed include B2-v2-H4/H8 as engineering robustness after core B3/B4; numerical reuse and new clock need approval, not best-config selection.
definition.compatibility_mode: Explicit LEGACY_GLOBAL_ACCEPT_CLOCK adapter for old B2 regression only; default per-link clock cannot claim legacy B2 equality.

definition.eta_member: actual Gate C usable_lifetime_s / remaining_lifetime_s (both current observed-window quantities; retain censor flags)
definition.score_proposal: S_batch=deltaV_batch*min_r eta_r for deltaV>0 and every remaining/usable>0
definition.selection: maximum positive S_batch, otherwise HOLD; exact ties common order
definition.interpretation: Myopic setup-aware choice over jointly constructed batches, not independent top-four or sequential summed benefits
definition.single_mode: min of one eta recovers old B3 formula when pool/root/router same
definition.min_eta_status: NEW_AGGREGATION_REQUIRES_HUMAN_FREEZE; conservative proxy, not exact queue-area/service loss theorem
definition.evaluate_new_prefix: Each extended retained prefix recomputes full graph and current service snapshot; never sum individual DeltaV.

baselines.name: Bounded Joint Root-Action Rollout
baselines.rule: argmin J_H over HOLD and every exact shared legal batch
baselines.forecast: current-rate persistence, common source per epoch, no actual future realization

baselines.name: Tiny exact batch oracle
baselines.role: Exhaustive legal root batches, not a future-traffic oracle in core contrasts
